The *Nāgapetavatthu* (Pv 11), rendered in English as "The Elephant", is a verse narrative included in the *Petavatthu* section of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The text highlights karmic themes centered around generosity, addressing the vital question of why it is important to give when one has the opportunity [SuttaCentral]. Four translations across four languages are cataloged on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
